main_body: Broad leafy canopy of rounded clumps on a brown trunk with a flared root base
top_band: Lightest greens (#71a854 / #4d8743) at rows 11-14 on the upper canopy clumps, then mid and dark greens below. No separate flat top surface, only a lit dome.
evidence: The canopy is a volumetric dome. Light clumps sit on the upper edges, and darker undersides and a shadow cluster sit lower where it overhangs the trunk. The trunk is a vertical form with a widened base. No receding side face is drawn. It reads as a lit-from-above organic mass, not a flat elevation, so it passes as an organic piece.

style.evidence: Clump shading uses about 6 lightness steps, and the dark edges are tinted dark green or brown rather than neutral black, so the outline is fine. The measured facts are far below both references. The candidate has 15 distinct colours against 427 and 567, and a median of 7 colours per tile against 108 and 109. The canopy is built from repeated, similar rounded clumps with few distinct highlight dots. The trunk is a plain brown ramp with little grain. Next to the references it looks thinner and more uniform, so it fails on density.
